title: Introduction to Poetry
description: Master the basics of rhythm, meter, and poetic devices through classic British and American poems.

title: Romantic Poetry
description: Dive deep into the works of Wordsworth, Keats, and Shelley. Detailed analysis of romanticism and nature.

title: Elizabethan & Jacobean Drama
description: Explore Shakespeare, Marlowe, and Webster. Discover the complexities of early modern theatre and tragedy.

title: Victorian Literature
description: Study the massive societal shifts reflected in the works of Tennyson, Browning, and Dickens.

title: Modern Drama
description: Analyze the breakdown of traditional narratives with Beckett, Osborne, and modern theatrical movements.

title: American Literature
description: From Whitman to Hemingway. Understand the distinct voice and thematic evolution of American writers.
